Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase, with >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli in culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. Mild hematuria is present. Elevated urine glucose and low specific gravity may suggest impaired renal concentrating ability or possible glycosuria. No ketones or casts detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy are recommended.
